profile.name: 串口通信设备
profile.description: 一种通过串行端口进行数据收发的实验设备或仪器接口，常见于带 UART、RS-232 或 USB 虚拟串口的实验仪器。它可用于实验室中与上位机交换文本或原始字节数据，并配置波特率、校验位、数据位、停止位以及 RTS/DTR 等串口通信参数。
profile.description_en: A laboratory device or instrument interface that communicates through a serial port, commonly using UART, RS-232, or a USB virtual COM port. It is used in labs to exchange text or raw byte data with a host computer and to configure serial communication parameters such as baud rate, parity, data bits, stop bits, and RTS/DTR control lines.
